description: Declared mutants of the model Module (docs/architecture/target/v2/model.zh-Hant.md; ids md- the model data rules, ma- skeletal animation's first layer, mr- retargeting, mf- the fbx loader and its adapter, mb- build-time link checks). One per independently wrong decision of Design Invariants MD-1 to MD-6 (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). Not added (with the reason): removing the before-the-first-key and after-the-last-key branches of the key search, or the empty-channel checks (each then reads outside a vector, undefined behaviour); the duration-0 branch of Wrap::Loop (without it fmod gives NaN, and a channel of a duration-0 clip has one key, so the value is the same); the unbound-track skip of Retarget (indexes with the unbound marker, undefined behaviour); Validate's BadData rule of the loader and the Unsupported rule (no file Blender writes reaches them); the equal-time key merge of the adapter (Blender's linear keys never collide); one skin per mesh, shared by its material parts (structural: the skin is made once per mesh, before the parts; the shared-skin case shows it); the mesh-skin range check of Validate (without it the check reads skins out of range, undefined behaviour); the PBR base colour fallback of the materials (Blender writes the FBX diffuse colour, so no file of ours reaches it); the importer memory limit following the byte limit (the contract example never nears 256 MiB, so no test sees the limit); in SolveTwoBoneIK, holding the distance between the two lengths' difference and their sum (without it the mid's height is held at 0 and only directions are used, so the chain is straight or folded the same way: an equivalent mutant), and the zero-length and degenerate checks of the bones (without them Normalize divides by 0, the same NaN the target-on-root mutant shows).
